name: Rosa Grand Milano – Starhotels Collezione
positioning: Starhotels Collezione hotel on Piazza Fontana in Milan, with refurbished rooms in peacock blue and gold and a Les Clefs d'Or concierge
best_for: Travelers who want a central Milan base on Piazza Fontana
Guests who value design-led rooms and concierge-arranged touring

facts.text: The hotel's address is Piazza Fontana, 3, in Milan.
The hotel reflects the Milanese taste for style and design and a passion for artistry.
The hotel's hallways wind through the building like a labyrinth.
The refurbished rooms are complemented by touches of sage green, ivory and gold leaf.
One room category is the Deluxe Duomo View room.
Rooms feature the Starbed and Pillowmania.
A personal trainer is available on request and must be reserved in advance.
Wi-Fi is free throughout the hotel and rooms.
A Porsche charging station is reserved for hotel guests as a complimentary service.
The hotel has meeting rooms with natural light and a dedicated event manager.
Breakfast at Roses features yogurt, fruit preserves and cheeses produced by small local farms.
The Grand Lounge & Bar has fine gold detailing, waxed walls and elegant furnishings.

highlights.text: In the refurbished rooms the dominant colour is peacock blue, with gold and pink accents.
The hotel has a Les Clefs d'Or concierge.
Guests can rent a car with a personal driver.
The wellness center has fitness facilities, a relaxation area and a solarium.
Sfizio, the hotel's flagship restaurant, has an outdoor terrace on Piazza Fontana enclosed by lush greenery.

considerations.text: The hotel is smoke-free: smoking is not allowed in the rooms or public areas.
Pets are welcome, but Rosa Grand charges a pet fee.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the hotel's luxury positioning.
